title: Java and Spring Boot
description: Conventions for Java and Spring Boot.

rules.title: Constructor injection
rules.text: Use constructor injection; avoid field injection.

rules.title: Records and immutability
rules.text: Use records and immutable types for DTOs.

rules.title: Controller, service, repository
rules.text: Keep controllers thin, logic in services and persistence in repositories.

rules.title: Bean validation
rules.text: Validate request bodies with Jakarta Bean Validation annotations.

rules.title: Optional for return values
rules.text: Use Optional only for return values, never for fields or parameters.

rules.title: Streams with care
rules.text: Use streams for transformations but fall back to loops when they hurt readability.

rules.title: Transactional boundaries
rules.text: Place @Transactional on service methods and keep transactions short.

rules.title: Typed configuration
rules.text: Bind configuration with @ConfigurationProperties instead of scattered @Value.

rules.title: Do not expose entities
rules.text: Do not return JPA entities from APIs; map to DTOs.

rules.title: Avoid lazy loading surprises
rules.text: Fetch associations explicitly and avoid open-session-in-view.

rules.title: SLF4J logging
rules.text: Log through SLF4J with parameterized messages.
